# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/ui_chancery.mjs, UI overhaul lane W2): the realm's roots and sign in the politics view.
scripted_gui = {
	zin_politics_realm = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "zin_politics_realm_window"
		parent_window_token = politics_tab
		visible = { always = yes }
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		triggers = {
			zin_politics_realm_toggle_click_enabled = { always = yes }
		}
		effects = {
			zin_politics_realm_toggle_click = {
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_politics_realm_open } clr_country_flag = zin_politics_realm_open }
				else = { set_country_flag = zin_politics_realm_open }
			}
		}
	}
	zin_politics_realm_page = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "zin_politics_realm_page_window"
		parent_window_token = politics_tab
		visible = { has_country_flag = zin_politics_realm_open }
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		triggers = {
			zin_politics_realm_close_click_enabled = { always = yes }
		}
		effects = {
			zin_politics_realm_close_click = { clr_country_flag = zin_politics_realm_open }
		}
	}
}
